mapper.sql: id, division_id, stage_id, structure_batch_id, structure_execution_version, rule_version_id, roster_version_id, pairing_execution_id, schedule_revision, publish_no, action_type, publish_status, schedule_fingerprint, operator_id, operation_time, reason, is_current, current_unique_key, create_time, update_time, is_delete
mapper.select: select from basket_stage_publish_record where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_stage_publish_record where stage_id = #{stageId} and is_current = 1 and is_delete = 0 order by id desc limit 1
select from basket_stage_publish_record where stage_id = #{stageId} and is_delete = 0 order by publish_no desc, id desc
select max(publish_no) from basket_stage_publish_record where stage_id = #{stageId} and is_delete = 0 and action_type in ('PUBLISH', 'REPUBLISH')
mapper.insert: insert into basket_stage_publish_record ( division_id, stage_id, structure_batch_id, structure_execution_version, rule_version_id, roster_version_id, pairing_execution_id, schedule_revision, publish_no, action_type, publish_status, schedule_fingerprint, operator_id, operation_time, reason, is_current, current_unique_key, create_time, update_time, is_delete ) values ( #{divisionId}, #{stageId}, #{structureBatchId}, #{structureExecutionVersion}, #{ruleVersionId}, #{rosterVersionId}, #{pairingExecutionId}, #{scheduleRevision}, #{publishNo}, #{actionType}, #{publishStatus}, #{scheduleFingerprint}, #{operatorId}, #{operationTime}, #{reason}, #{isCurrent}, #{currentUniqueKey}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete} )
mapper.update: update basket_stage_publish_record set is_current = 0, current_unique_key = null, update_time = now() where stage_id = #{stageId} and is_current = 1 and is_delete = 0
